fr_html: Le PRESIDENT demande à Mr. Root s'il ne croit pas nécessaire de distinguer entre la compétence ratione materiae et les sources auxquelles le juge doit puiser pour fonder son jugement. Il a d'autre part l'impression que le droit international tel que le conçoit Lord Phillimore, se rapproche du droit naturel.
en_html: The PRESIDENT asked Mr. Root if he did not think it would be necessary to distinguish between the competence ratione materiae and the sources from which the judge should draw to base his judgment. He had formed the impression in another connection that international law as understood by Lord Phillimore resembled natural law.
